page_title: WER 0-4 STU | Werder Bremen v Stuttgart 14/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+7' 0 - 4 Goal! A terrific long pass from Maximilian Mittelstadt picks out an unmarked Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:4.
90+6' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
90+6' A fine solo run by Badredine Bouanani (VfB Stuttgart) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies high over the bar.
90+6' Badredine Bouanani (VfB Stuttgart) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

90+5' What a wasted opportunity by Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart)! He creates himself some space inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the top right corner, but Mio Backhaus makes an astonishing save to thwart him. Stuttgart have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+3' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
90+3' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him. Werder Bremen win a free kick.
90+1' Stuttgart have been given a corner kick after the ball crosses the byline.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Werder Bremen are awarded a corner kick.
89' Sebastian Hoeness prepares a substitution. Finn Jeltsch is replaced by Ameen Al Dakhil (VfB Stuttgart).
89' Substitution. Deniz Undav will be replaced by Badredine Bouanani (VfB Stuttgart).
89' The attendance is 42100.
89' Excellent touch by Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a terrific save.
88' Mio Backhaus displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

87' A big opportunity is wasted by Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the roof of the net. Unfortunately for him, Mio Backhaus pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.
87' Corner kicks – 0:8.
84' A precise short pass from Maximilian Mittelstadt releases Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot high over the bar.
83' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

82' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed into the top left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. Corner kick. Stuttgart will have an opportunity.
82' The corner from Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) is intercepted by Mio Backhaus.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jamie Leweling trots off the pitch and is replaced by Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart).
82' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The linesman makes the right call and Stuttgart will have a corner.
81' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper.
79' 0 - 3 Goal! Jamie Leweling pulls the ball back for Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) on the edge of the box, and he beats the keeper with a fine strike into the top left corner. 0:3.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Senne Lynen leaves the pitch and Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) comes on.
77' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Justin Njinmah.
76' It will be a substitution. Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) is ready to enter the pitch as Bilal El Khannouss walks off.
76' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to make a change. Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Nikolas Nartey.
75' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
74' Nikolas Nartey (VfB Stuttgart) gets to a rebound from the corner kick and unleashes a long-range shot. Promising try, but it goes way wide of the left post.
74' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

73' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the roof of the net. Mio Backhaus pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. It will be a corner kick for Stuttgart.
72' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Robert Hartmann blows for a foul.

70' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Stuttgart.
69' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) sprays a pass out to Jens Stage, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
68' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) makes a good run to latch onto the free kick from Bilal El Khannouss, but pushes his close-range header high over the bar.
68' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 7:13. Shots on target – 2:5.

67' Ambitious effort from Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
64' Horst Steffen decides to make a substitution. Marco Grull will be replaced by Keke Topp (Werder Bremen).
64' The manager makes a subsitution with Isaac Schmidt (Werder Bremen) coming on for Samuel Mbangula.
63' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to find Josha Vagnoman with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
62' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

61' A sweet pass finds Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. Mio Backhaus is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
60' The corner from Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) is cleared away by the defence.
59' It's the second caution for Karim Coulibaly (Werder Bremen) and that's the last we'll see of him in this game. There was no other option for Robert Hartmann.

59' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) is quick to pounce on the rebound inside the penalty area and fires in a shot towards the roof of the net, but is denied by a reflex save from Mio Backhaus. The referee signals a corner kick to Stuttgart.
57' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
57' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) is substituted due to injury. Horst Steffen gives a chance to Niklas Stark.
55' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
52' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
52' Robert Hartmann couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) and blew his whistle.
50' Romano Schmid looks up and sends over a pin-point cross to Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) near the penalty spot, but he totally fluffs his lines and plants a tame header well wide of the right post.
50' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
48' Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. A free kick to Stuttgart.
47' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
46' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) is penalised for holding. Robert Hartmann signals a set piece. It's a free kick to Werder Bremen, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+2' The free kick is delivered by Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

44' 0 - 2 What a beautiful moment! Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top of the net. Mio Backhaus just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 0:2.
41' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

40' 0 - 1 Jamie Leweling showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) gets onto the scoresheet by heading inside the left post. It's 0:1.
38' The corner by Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.

37' What a great chance for Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save. Stuttgart have been awarded a corner kick.
37' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner with a short pass.
37' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just wide of the left post.
33' Robert Hartmann blows for a foul after Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
33' Total attempts – 4:2. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 2:0.

32' Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the right side of the goal. His effort is blocked by Alexander Nubel with a brilliant diving save!
32' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
31' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
30' Karim Coulibaly (Werder Bremen) sends a long cross over to Justin Njinmah, but Alexander Nubel comes forward to gather the ball.

28' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
27' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
24' Celebrations are cut short for Stuttgart as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
24' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Stuttgart players aren’t happy.
23' Goal! Angelo Stiller gets to the ball, slips Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) into the area and he scores with a delightful chipped finish to make it 0:1.
22' A pass from Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) is intercepted by Mio Backhaus and the move breaks down.
21' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alexander Nubel, who smothers the ball.
19' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
19' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
17' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
16' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
16' The ball possession is 40:60.
11' This is a yellow card! Karim Coulibaly (Werder Bremen) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
10' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.

9' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the bottom right corner, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Alexander Nubel. What a save!
9' Half-chance! Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) plays a pass into the box, but Alexander Nubel reacts well to snuff out the attack.
6' Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
5' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) sends a cross in and finds Deniz Undav inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
3' Big chance! A simple pass from Romano Schmid left Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) with just the keeper to beat inside the box, but his shot went agonisingly just past the left post.
2' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart).
1' The first half has started.
Stuttgart will kick-off.
Robert Hartmann will supervise the game today.
